title: Werken bij Stork-apparatenbouw 1974
authors: Universiteit van Amsterdam * Amsterdam, Instituut voor wetenschap der politiek, IWP,  Doktoraal onderwijsgroep politiek in grote groepen, DOGRO (primary investigator)
contributors: Doktoraal onderwijsgroep politiek in grote groepen, UvA * AmsterdamSubfakulteit algemene politieke en sociale wetenschappen, UvA * Amsterdam (data collector)
descriptions: Opinions of workers, employees on industrial relations / details on works council / co-partnership / participation / working conditions / job satisfaction / trade unions / strikes / workers taking over plant / who must play a role in achieving industrial democracy / most opinions asked in relation to and sometimes after exposure to television program about subjects as above mentioned. Background variables: basic characteristics/ place of work/ occupation/employment/ education/ politics/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure
